retrofit: isa-calling-conventions — closing ``` of the 20!/21! formula block had prose on the same line (block never closed); split onto its own line.

retrofit: isa-calling-conventions — L_max definition said two's complement 'keeps one bit pattern's worth of range for the sign'; now: the top bit carries the sign, so the positive range stops at 2^63 − 1.

retrofit: isa-compile-link-load (lesson + q formula) — R_X86_64_PLT32 written as S + A − P and claimed to be the psABI definition; psABI defines it as L + A − P (L = PLT entry). Formula now uses L; prose states main at 0x401000 so the example is self-consistent.
retrofit: isa-compile-link-load — 'containers' linked to the container data-structure term (Arch 05); now 'Linux containers' with a new linux-container term.
retrofit: isa-compile-link-load q — 'kernel forwarding operation' linked to pipeline operand forwarding; reworded to 'the kernel to pass the call on'.
retrofit: glossary callee-saved — alias 'non-volatile' captured 'non-volatile storage/SRAM' in Arch 02; replaced with 'non-volatile registers' and lesson reworded.

retrofit: glossary v-registers — alias 'vector registers' pointed general (x86 and ARM) uses in Arch 03 and Arch 06 at an ARM64-only entry; alias removed and a general simd-vector-registers term added.
retrofit: glossary thumb-2 — alias 'Thumb' captured 'rule of thumb' in Arch 01/02; removed.
retrofit: glossary register-spill — aliases 'spills'/'spilling' captured 'data that spills to DRAM' in Arch 05; replaced with 'spills and reloads', lesson says 'register spills'.
retrofit: glossary mold — said 'for ELF and other formats'; mold supports ELF only; corrected.
retrofit: glossary lp64 — alias ILP32 had no matching sense in the definition; definition now explains ILP32.

retrofit: glossary branch-misprediction — unhedged '10–20 cycles' contradicted the lesson's omission of a universal penalty; now hedged as core-dependent, often around 10–20 cycles on long-pipeline cores.

retrofit: glossary bounds-check / buffer-overflow / imul / plt32 — definitions broadened to cover the senses their aliases capture (switch range check, out-of-bounds reads, RISC-V mul in Arch 04, direct PLT32 resolution).
retrofit: glossary gold — added the binutils 2.44 (Feb 2025) deprecation detail with LWN source.
